decision.observation: Farmer is wedged in the narrow grass gap between the blue house (west) and a darker house (east) at 10:40 pm; the street with lampposts and posts lies below, and the axe tooltip still partly overlays.

decision.memory: Home route: town street → west → bus stop corridor → farm north gap → farmhouse. Introductions 7/28; 450g; half energy.
